title: Weinberg Capital Partners acquires niche perfume house Etat Libre d'Orange
summary: Niche perfume house Etat Libre d'Orange has been acquired by Weinberg Capital Partners, the independent investment firm that already owns Juliette Has A Gun, acquired in 2023.
